name: ai-assets-scanner-dev
description: Dev tooling for the AI Assets Scanner WordPress plugin. NOT shipped to customers: build-release.py's TOP_FILES is an explicit 5-file whitelist and does not include this file. Deliberately carries no "version" field - the plugin version lives in exactly three places (ai-assets-scanner.php header, CU_SCANNER_VERSION, README.md badge) and a fourth copy here would be one more surface to drift.
